name: Rob Morgan
bio: Rob Morgan (born February 24, 1973) is an American actor. He is known for his role as Turk Barrett in the series “Daredevil,” as well as appearing in “Jessica Jones,” “Luke Cage,” “Iron Fist,” “The Defenders,” and “The Punisher,” making him the only actor to appear in all six of Marvel's Netflix television series. He has also starred in the films “Don’t Look Up,” “Smile,” and “Mudbound.”

credits.overview: Frank, serving a life sentence, takes a prison job caring for aging incarcerated men with Alzheimer’s and dementia. What begins as a self-interested bid for parole becomes a profound, transformative bond with fellow prisoner Louis, offering Frank a glimpse of redemption in an unforgiving place.

Bryan fights tirelessly for Walter with the system stacked against them.
